# Bundled CIDS files

These two files are copied unchanged from the Common Impact Data Standard
repository (<https://github.com/commonapproach/CIDS>, version 3.2.1) so that
validation works offline:

- `cids.basictier.shacl.ttl` — from `validation/shacl/`
- `cidsContext.jsonld` — from `contexts/`
